title: investigate and decompose gap route-edit-aebb5d76: The GET /conservation-audit route is registered TWICE in repos/activi
description:
investigate and decompose gap route-edit-aebb5d76: The GET /conservation-audit route is registered TWICE in repos/activity-api/src/routes/activities.ts with byte-identical handler bodies (verified by diffing the two blocks: the only difference was a trailing brace from the slice boundary). The framework serves the FIRST registration, so the second is unreachable dead code.

TWO CONSEQUENCES.
1. Dead code: roughly 80 lines that can never execute.
